rv.q: By turns devastating and quick-witted, scintillating yet unexpectedly moving, the piece raises all sorts of hopes for Goold's embyronic Almeida tenure.
The ensemble cast delivers strongly throughout and exudes confidence.

cn.t: Goold's musical adaptation of Ellis's capitalist critique earns strong praise as a standout achievement in a crowded musical theater season, with its sell-out success cementing its status as a fitting highlight.
